name: Bootstrap Process Manager
description: PID 1 entrypoint that manages Caddy gateway and Streamlit portal, auto-restarts crashed services

name: Heartbeat Cycle Runner
description: Single-cycle execution engine triggered via docker exec; loads memory, executes prompts via Claude SDK

name: Caddy Gateway
description: HTTP reverse proxy on port 8080; routes to Streamlit, file browser, and static files; dynamic reconfiguration via admin API

name: Streamlit Web Portal
description: Multi-tab web portal at /app/ with hot-reload; dashboard, chat, and grouped feature tabs

name: Memory Persistence
description: JSON-based persistent memory system (state, cycles, journal, goals); survives container restarts

name: Message Queue
description: Inbox/outbox message passing for goals, messages, and human-needs-input signals

name: Prompt Selection Engine
description: Automatic prompt routing based on agent state: bootstrap, self-heal, goal execution, or evolution

name: File Browser
description: Caddy-served file browser at /_/ for browsing agent filesystem with download links

name: Portal Configuration
description: Unified portal configuration for hostname (public Cloudflare Tunnel URL), timezone, and HTTP basic auth; replaces legacy portal-hostname and portal-auth scripts

name: Cycle Start Briefing
description: Startup briefing combining memory repair, state summary, recent journal, inbox peek, and evolve recommendation

name: Cycle Close Automation
description: Auto-close cycles by updating state, marking completion with duration, appending journal entry

name: Memory Repair
description: Detects and auto-repairs corrupted JSON memory files; restores from backups or safe defaults

name: Memory Backup
description: Timestamped snapshots of critical memory files; supports restore and pruning (keeps max 20)

name: Journal Archival
description: Archives old journal entries (>20 cycles) to keep active journal lean for fast loading

name: Memory Sync
description: Generates .md auto-memory files from JSON memory data (state, capabilities, goals); makes memory accessible to the agent's memory system

name: Long-Term Memory Ingest
description: Bulk-ingests journal, cycle, and goal data into a memvid .mv2 semantic memory index; supports incremental append and raw text/file ingestion

name: Long-Term Memory Recall
description: Queries the memvid .mv2 semantic memory index; retrieves past cycle experiences, related historical work, and chronological timeline browsing

name: Memory Q&A
description: RAG-powered natural-language Q&A over memvid .mv2 long-term memory; retrieves adaptive context then synthesizes answers via Claude

name: KeePass Credential Manager
description: Local KeePass database for API keys, passwords, and secrets; CLI get/store/list/search; imported directly by services to avoid subprocess spawns

name: Chat Interface
description: Claude SDK chat UI with streaming responses, tool use display, and persistent history

name: Telegram Bridge
description: Bridges inbox/outbox with a Telegram bot; polls for incoming messages, forwards outbox to Telegram, auto-discovers chat ID; supports /remind, /note, /notes, /status, /goals, /services commands; writes heartbeat for liveness monitoring

name: WhatsApp Bridge
description: Bridges inbox/outbox with WhatsApp Business Cloud API; receives messages via webhook on port 8083, forwards outbox to WhatsApp, auto-discovers owner phone; writes heartbeat for liveness monitoring

name: CallMeBot Voice Escalation
description: Voice call escalation via CallMeBot Telegram API; calls the human when a needs_human outbox message goes unanswered; credentials stored in KeePass

name: Email IMAP Client
description: IMAP email client supporting any provider; fetch, search, delete, and verify emails using credentials from KeePass (entry 'Email IMAP' with server URL, username, and app password)

name: Metrics Collector
description: Time-series metrics for Streamlit response time, CPU, memory, and disk usage

name: Self-Test Suite
description: Comprehensive test suite validating API endpoints, memory files, disk health, processes, and imports

name: Health Check
description: Multi-service health check with retry logic for Streamlit and Caddy endpoints

name: App Render Check
description: Headless AppTest framework catching syntax errors, missing imports, and runtime exceptions

name: Cycle Reporting
description: Summary reports of agent activity showing recent cycles with duration, type, and category

name: Milestone Reporting
description: Narrative growth snapshots at significant cycle intervals (25, 50, 75, 100...)

name: Auto Maintenance
description: Memory validation, journal archival, log cleanup, zombie process detection, and disk usage reporting

name: Task Scheduler
description: Evaluates scheduled_tasks.json for due tasks; supports interval, once, and cron schedules; features include --forecast (48h timeline), --history (per-task execution ring buffer), --run-now, --test (cron dry-run), and execution stats

name: Reminder Manager
description: Create and manage personal reminders that fire as inbox messages via the scheduler; supports one-time (--at), recurring (--every N minutes), and cron-based (--cron) reminders

name: Service Manager
description: Manages long-running background services (optional port 8082-8090); start, stop, restart, status, health-check (with heartbeat staleness detection), list, and cleanup; atomic state files prevent concurrent corruption

name: Webhook Receiver
description: Generic HTTP webhook handler on port 8082; records POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE payloads to webhook.json; Caddy routes /webhook/* to this service; managed via service-manager

name: Agent Browser
description: Headless Chromium automation via agent-browser CLI for web interaction and scraping

name: Skill Creator
description: Create new skills from scratch, modify and improve existing skills, run evals, and benchmark skill performance with variance analysis and triggering accuracy optimization

name: Notes Manager
description: Personal notes and scratchpad; add, list, search, edit, delete, tag, pin, export (Markdown/JSON), and view stats; importable as a Python module by services for direct in-process note creation

name: Workspace File Upload
description: Upload files from local machine to /agent/workspace/ via portal with subdirectory support

name: Command Center
description: Portal tab for sending goals/messages, running scripts, and browsing command history

name: Memory Viewer
description: Portal tab for browsing journal, logs, goals, and memory files with cross-file search

name: System Diagnostics
description: Portal tab for health checks, error tracking, validation, services, and script inventory

name: Overview Dashboard
description: Portal tab with suggestions, goal performance, evolution balance, and activity summary
